business_summary: Muromachi Chemicals Inc. plans, produces, and distributes pharmaceuticals, health foods, and chemicals in Japan. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediate synthesis products; commissioned processing services for pharmaceuticals; and import and sale of active pharmaceutical ingredients; and radioisotope. The company also provides ion-exchange resins; separation membranes; water-treatment products; and contract processing services, as well as engages in the manufacturing and sales of urea solutions. In addition, it provides functional adhesives, functional pastes, greases, conductive adhesives, UV-curable adhesives, Blut-Z serum and plasma separation materials, static electricity control products, liquid removal rolls, screen printing machines, UV irradiation machines, laminator equipment, and adhesive and functional paste contract manufacturing, processing, and filling services. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Omuta, Japan.
